meta.title: This Silent Room Will Drive You Insane In 45 Minutes #shorts
meta.description:
Have you ever wondered what absolute, terrifying silence actually sounds like? Deep inside Microsoft's headquarters sits a room so quiet that it holds a Guinness World Record. It is called an anechoic chamber, and it blocks out every single external sound. But if you step inside and close the heavy door, you won't find peace. Instead, your ears desperately try to find something to listen to. Within seconds, you will hear your own lungs breathing. Soon, the sound of your heartbeat becomes a deafening thud, and you can even hear your bones grinding together when you move. Most people cannot stand being inside this room for more than forty-five minutes before they begin hallucinating. Would you dare to spend an hour inside this silent room? Let me know in the comments.
